preconditions.description: The number of vertices n is an integer between 2 and 100,000 inclusive.
The input contains exactly n-1 edges describing the tree.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n for u, v in edges)
preconditions.description: All edge endpoints are valid vertex indices between 1 and n.
The graph formed by the edges is a tree (connected and acyclic).

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly n lines, one for each k from 1 to n.

postconditions.expression: all(output_lines[i] == str(max_paths(n, edges, k=i+1)) for i in range(n))
postconditions.description: The i-th line (0-indexed) contains the maximum number of disjoint paths of length k=i+1 that can be formed in the tree, where each vertex belongs to at most one path.
